title: Apple Sharing
text: Sarah has 24 apples. She wants to share them equally among 6 friends. How many apples does each friend get?

title: Sticker Packs
text: A store sells stickers in packs of 8. Jake bought 5 packs. How many stickers does Jake have in total?
expected_steps: Identify operation: groups of equal size → multiplication

title: Baking Cookies
text: A baker made 36 cookies and put them into bags of 4. Then she sold 3 bags. How many cookies are left?
expected_steps: Step 1: Find how many bags total: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 bags

title: Lemonade Stand
text: Mia earned $5 on Monday and $8 on Tuesday from her lemonade stand. She spent $4 on lemons. How much money does she have left?

title: Pizza Fractions
text: Tom ate 2/8 of a pizza and Lisa ate 3/8 of the same pizza. What fraction of the pizza did they eat in total?
expected_steps: Denominators are the same (both 8) — no conversion needed
Answer: They ate 5/8 of the pizza

title: Running Distance
text: Ana ran 3/4 of a mile in the morning and 1/2 of a mile in the evening. How far did she run in total?
expected_steps: Denominators are different (4 and 2) — find LCD

title: Equivalent Fractions Puzzle
text: Fill in the blank: 2/3 = ?/12. What number goes in the blank?
expected_steps: Find what multiplied the denominator: 3 × ? = 12, so ? = 4

title: Ribbon Cutting
text: A ribbon is 5/6 meter long. Maria cuts off 1/3 meter. How much ribbon is left?
expected_steps: Answer: 1/2 meter of ribbon is left

title: Fraction of a Group
text: A bag has 4 cookies. Tim's mom gives him 3 bags. How many cookies does Tim have? Write your answer as a multiplication of a fraction and whole number.

title: Dividing Pizza Equally
text: You have 3 pizzas to share equally among 4 people. What fraction of a pizza does each person get?
expected_steps: Answer: Each person gets 3/4 of a pizza

title: Flower Garden
text: How many groups of 1/3 are in 2? (i.e., 2 ÷ 1/3 = ?)
expected_steps: Dividing by a fraction → multiply by its reciprocal
Answer: There are 6 groups of 1/3 in 2

title: Algebra: Bag of Marbles
text: Let m represent the number of marbles in a bag. Write an expression for: 'three bags of marbles plus 5 extra marbles.'

title: Book Price Expression
text: A bookstore charges $p for a paperback and $h for a hardcover. Write an expression for buying 2 paperbacks and 1 hardcover.

title: Solve for x: Simple
text: Solve: x + 7 = 15

title: Solve for x: Division
text: Solve: 4x = 28

title: Two-Step Equation
text: Solve: 2x + 3 = 11
expected_steps: Step 2: Divide both sides by 2: 2x/2 = 8/2 → x = 4

title: Word Problem → Equation
text: Maya is 3 years older than twice her brother's age. Maya is 17. How old is her brother? Write and solve an equation.
expected_steps: Answer: Maya's brother is 7 years old

title: Negative Numbers: Temperature
text: The temperature was -4°C in the morning. By noon it rose 9°C. What is the temperature at noon?
expected_steps: Answer: The temperature at noon is 5°C

title: Fraction Multiplication
text: A recipe calls for 2/3 cup of sugar. If you want to make 3 batches, how much sugar do you need?
expected_steps: Answer: You need 2 cups of sugar

title: Challenge: Inequality
text: Solve and graph: 3x - 6 > 9
expected_steps: Divide both sides by 3 (positive, so inequality stays): x > 5
Graph: open circle at 5, arrow pointing right
